newsitem.title: USA: Mikasa to buy back 1.69 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Mikasa to buy back 1.69 mln shares.

text.p: Mikasa Inc said on Monday it expects to buy back nearly 1.69 million shares of its stock, based on a preliminary count by the depositary for its "Dutch auction" self-tender offer.
The company said the purchase price would be around $11.25 a share, in accordance with the terms of its offer, which expired September 6.
Under the offer, which began August 8, the company offered to purchase up to 1,777,777 shares at a price not greater than $11.25 a share and not less than $9.375.
Based on a preliminary count, about 1,688,647 shares were properly tendered and not withdrawn, including about 631,900 shares subject to guarantees of delivery.
The company said it expects to accept for purchase all shares properly tendered and not withdrawn.
The shares to be purchased represent about 8.42 percent of the shares outstanding immediately prior to the tender offer.
